title: Platform key and parent account
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S01
expected_invariant: Real Whop account, explicit sandbox base, enablement email sent and acknowledged, one parent account ID and one Account API key whose scope inventory lists only the scopes the later scenarios use.

failure_cases.name: scope inventory
failure_cases.expect: Redacted scope list reviewed; nothing beyond the minimum for S02 to S10.

failure_cases.name: enablement acknowledged
failure_cases.expect: Sponsor reply on file; transfers and payouts capabilities read back as active before S06 and S07 start.

notes: Key creation happens in the dashboard by Alex. The record holds the key ID and scope names, never the secret. The enablement email was reported sent before this lane opened; its acknowledgement is still pending.

title: Three sellers, idempotent onboarding
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S02
expected_invariant: Exactly one connected account per external ID and environment for US, DE and BR, each with parent_company_id, email and metadata.external_id readable back.

failure_cases.name: restart mid-create
failure_cases.expect: Process killed after the request and before the local write; rerun resolves to the same account, no second create.

failure_cases.name: concurrent create
failure_cases.expect: Two callers with the same external ID produce one local seller row.

title: Duplicate create and nested parent
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S03
expected_invariant: Second create for the same seller returns the observed provider behaviour verbatim; create under a connected account returns a provider error and no account.

failure_cases.name: nested parent rejected
failure_cases.expect: Error body captured; account list before and after has the same count.

notes: The provider's duplicate behaviour is unknown until observed. Record what happened, do not predict it.

title: Onboarding link and readback
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S04
expected_invariant: account_onboarding link created for one seller; Alex completes it; before and after reads differ in verification, required_actions and capabilities.

failure_cases.name: before and after differ
failure_cases.expect: Named fields changed between the two redacted reads; return URL reached is not the proof.

title: Direct charge, fee in both ledgers, refund
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S05
expected_invariant: US seller checkout with inline plan and application_fee_amount equal to 8% of gross; sandbox card pays; fee and seller share appear in both ledgers; refund recorded with the fee's actual outcome.

failure_cases.name: fee rounding
failure_cases.expect: Boundary amounts round the way the agreed policy says, per currency scale.

failure_cases.name: fee rejected
failure_cases.expect: A checkout with a fee not equal to 8% fails validation before any provider call.

title: Parent charge and Brazil transfer
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S06
expected_invariant: Same item sold on the Ledgerly account; transfers.create moves the BR seller share; parent debit and child credit balance in the transfer currency.

failure_cases.name: empty balance
failure_cases.expect: Balance read first. If empty, the record is blocked with the top-up gate or not applicable with the reason. No unauthorised funding.

title: Embedded payouts, rail markup, hosted portal
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S07
expected_invariant: Server maps the logged-in seller to its account, mints a token with explicit nonempty scoped_actions and a short expires_at, renders the embedded components on our page in sandbox mode; one rail markup saved and read back; payouts_portal link opens for the same seller.

failure_cases.name: sibling denied
failure_cases.expect: A request naming another seller's account ID is refused server-side.

failure_cases.name: empty scopes rejected
failure_cases.expect: Token route refuses an empty scoped_actions list.

failure_cases.name: expiry honoured
failure_cases.expect: Token past expires_at is not reused.

notes: Sandbox guide says payouts are unavailable, checked 2026-09-08. Mounted components are browser evidence only. What the assessment environment can show stays blocked on G01.

title: Webhook subscription, consumer, test and replay
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S08
expected_invariant: One platform webhook with child_resource_events true and the eight exact events; signature verified over raw bytes; one business effect per event across restart; test delivery and one replay recorded with provider delivery IDs and the deliveries-endpoint excerpt.

failure_cases.name: tampered body
failure_cases.expect: Signature check fails; nothing is persisted.

failure_cases.name: stale timestamp
failure_cases.expect: webhook-timestamp older than five minutes is rejected.

failure_cases.name: same webhook-id twice
failure_cases.expect: Second delivery acknowledged, no second effect.

failure_cases.name: regenerated-id replay
failure_cases.expect: Replay with regenerate_id arrives as a new message; effect dedupe still yields one ledger effect.

failure_cases.name: crash before ack
failure_cases.expect: Inbox row exists, effect applied once after restart.

failure_cases.name: unknown seller
failure_cases.expect: Event for an unmapped account is quarantined, not dropped.

notes: Test-event deliveries are samples. Records from them carry sample_payload true. Whether samples satisfy SUBMIT-04 is unknown; see decision.md.

title: Suspend one seller, per-seller API key
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S09
expected_invariant: One connected account suspended with pre and post readbacks; one API key scoped to a single connected account, created through the authorised user session, secret never recorded.

failure_cases.name: sibling access denied
failure_cases.expect: The per-seller key cannot read a sibling account.

title: Reconciliation with deliberate drift
command: TBD after Q02: ledgerly evidence run S10
expected_invariant: Job pages through one seller's payments and transfers from Whop and diffs them against the local ledger by currency; a clean run reports zero discrepancies; a seeded local drift is reported and not repaired.

failure_cases.name: seeded drift
failure_cases.expect: One local entry altered; the report names it with both sides' values and takes no corrective write.

failure_cases.name: pagination
failure_cases.expect: More entries than one page; all are compared.
